source_snapshot.procedure: Heat or use a BMC command to drive GPU temperature to over-temperature and expect system shutdown.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL changes the mechanism to over-current stress and relies on shutdown/dmesg without a vendor-safe trigger.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Identifies irreconcilable over-temperature versus over-current semantics and requires a vendor-approved non-damaging trigger, threshold, persistent evidence and controlled recovery.

old_problem: Master defines GPU over-temperature while DeepSeek redefines over-current; these protection mechanisms, sensors, events and shutdown paths are not interchangeable, and the source suggests potentially damaging heating or an unspecified BMC command.
disposition_reason: No ED-01–ED-30 rule selects over-temperature versus over-current or authorizes a trigger. Parameterization cannot invent an OEM protection injection, threshold, shutdown deadline or recovery. Generic stress/power-off evidence is insufficient and unsafe; the mechanism must remain pending project authority.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row158 all18 XLSX cells and history2764.
Kept Master over-temperature and DeepSeek over-current as explicitly conflicting evidence rather than merging them.
Prohibited ad hoc heating, current injection, generic stress and guessed BMC raw commands. No protection, power or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: GPU protection shutdown validation pending authoritative mechanism and safe injection
test_case.purpose: After project authority selects the protection mechanism, verify a vendor-approved non-damaging over-temperature or over-current stimulus causes the mechanism-specific controlled shutdown and leaves persistent evidence plus recoverable hardware state.
required_package: Authoritative decision: over-temperature, over-current, or separately versioned variants
Vendor-approved non-damaging injection/simulation tool, exact target and command/procedure
Mechanism-specific threshold/tolerance, event code and shutdown deadline/oracle
Qualified operator, isolated lab, OOB access, single-attempt abort and recovery/inspection plan
test_case.test_command: Do not execute while the mechanism and OEM method are unresolved. After approval, apply only the vendor-qualified injection to the exact mapped GPU/sensor, capture pre-trigger baseline and mechanism-specific threshold/event, prove the complete ON-to-OFF transition and persistent off-host evidence, then recover only under the approved single recovery plan. Never use ad hoc heating, generic stress or guessed raw BMC commands.
test_case.expected_result: The selected protection threshold is reached through the approved safe stimulus, the matching OEM event is recorded, the SUT completes the defined controlled shutdown within the approved deadline, and post-event inspection/recovery shows no hardware damage or unrelated trip.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires mechanism-specific trigger, threshold, event and complete shutdown evidence plus approved recovery. A power-off alone, software crash, PSU trip or wrong protection mechanism cannot pass.
safety_gate: No execution without OEM-approved non-damaging injection and isolated-lab authorization.
Operator and OOB telemetry must be active before stimulus; existing logs must be preserved.
One controlled attempt only; no automatic retry, escalating stimulus or improvised heating/current injection.
Abort on wrong sensor/GPU, uncontrolled temperature/current, missing telemetry, unexpected power behavior or lost recovery.
expected_evidence: OEM injection procedure/tool/version and target map
Persistent mechanism-specific event and complete ON-to-OFF timeline
Operator/OOB record, post-event inspection, recovery and final health
test_case.recovery: Keep the SUT off after the protection event, preserve persistent telemetry, inspect according to OEM safety procedure, and restore power only once the platform/GPU owner authorizes the defined recovery. Do not clear events or retry.

source_conflict.reason: Master over-temperature and DeepSeek over-current remain materially different protection mechanisms without an approved disposition.

blocked.reason: Static review is complete, but execution is prohibited until the mechanism and vendor-safe injection/recovery are supplied.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Select protection mechanism/variants and approve exact safe injection, threshold/event, shutdown oracle and recovery.
pending.owner: GPU vendor, platform power/thermal/BMC and lab safety owners.
pending.unlock_condition: Provide authoritative mechanism identity and a vendor-qualified non-damaging, observable and recoverable test lifecycle.

project_authority: Protection injection semantics, OEM thresholds/events and recovery are irreducible project/vendor authority.
